Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2027

Pittsburgh, PA

Lumen Robotics builds warehouse robots that work safely alongside people. Our interns ship production code from week one.

About the role

You will join the Fleet Software team, which builds the services that dispatch and monitor robots across customer sites. This is an on-site internship in our Pittsburgh office.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement REST APIs in Go and Python
  • Write unit tests and participate in code review
  • Improve dashboards that operations teams use every day

Qualifications

  • Pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028
  • Proficiency in at least one of Python, Go, Java, or C++
  • Understanding of data structures and algorithms
  • Experience with Git and Linux development environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Docker or Kubernetes
  • Previous internship or significant project work involving PostgreSQL

The hourly pay range for this internship is $40 - $48 per hour.

Lumen Robotics is an equal opportunity employer.
